constraints.definition: CHECK ((string_value IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'stringValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (integer_value IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'integerValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (double_value IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'doubleValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (boolean_value IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'booleanValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (timestamp_value IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'timestampValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (bytes_value IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'bytesValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (reference_value IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'referenceValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (latitude IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'geoPointValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (longitude IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'geoPointValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind) AND (members_present IS NOT NULL) = (kind = ANY (ARRAY['mapValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind, 'arrayValue'::epav_migration.firestore_kind])))

objects.name: current_documents
objects.definition:
SELECT d.snapshot_id,
    d.path,
    d.collection_path,
    d.document_id,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at,
    d.row_id
   FROM epav_migration.documents d
     JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (snapshots.source_database) snapshots.id
           FROM epav_migration.snapshots
          ORDER BY snapshots.source_database, snapshots.source_read_time DESC) latest ON latest.id = d.snapshot_id;

objects.name: products
objects.definition:
SELECT document_id AS id,
    ( SELECT record_fields.string_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields
          WHERE record_fields.document_row_id = r.row_id AND record_fields.parent_no IS NULL AND record_fields.field_name::text = 'nome'::text) AS nome,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(record_fields.string_value, record_fields.integer_value::character varying) AS "coalesce"
           FROM epav_data.record_fields
          WHERE record_fields.document_row_id = r.row_id AND record_fields.parent_no IS NULL AND record_fields.field_name::text = 'codigo'::text) AS codigo,
    ( SELECT record_fields.boolean_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields
          WHERE record_fields.document_row_id = r.row_id AND record_fields.parent_no IS NULL AND record_fields.field_name::text = 'disponivelNoJogo'::text) AS disponivel,
    ARRAY( SELECT f.string_value::character varying(240) AS string_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields p
             JOIN epav_data.record_fields f ON f.document_row_id = p.document_row_id AND f.parent_no = p.node_no
          WHERE p.document_row_id = r.row_id AND p.parent_no IS NULL AND p.field_name::text = 'tiposProduto'::text
          ORDER BY f.array_index) AS tipos,
    ARRAY( SELECT f.string_value::character varying(240) AS string_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields p
             JOIN epav_data.record_fields f ON f.document_row_id = p.document_row_id AND f.parent_no = p.node_no
          WHERE p.document_row_id = r.row_id AND p.parent_no IS NULL AND p.field_name::text = 'ocasioes'::text
          ORDER BY f.array_index) AS ocasioes,
    ( SELECT f.string_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields p
             JOIN epav_data.record_fields f ON f.document_row_id = p.document_row_id AND f.parent_no = p.node_no
          WHERE p.document_row_id = r.row_id AND p.parent_no IS NULL AND p.field_name::text = 'imagemSwift'::text AND f.field_name::text = 'url'::text) AS imagem_url,
    ( SELECT f.string_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields p
             JOIN epav_data.record_fields f ON f.document_row_id = p.document_row_id AND f.parent_no = p.node_no
          WHERE p.document_row_id = r.row_id AND p.parent_no IS NULL AND p.field_name::text = 'dadosOriginais'::text AND f.field_name::text = 'Marca'::text) AS marca,
    ( SELECT f.string_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields p
             JOIN epav_data.record_fields f ON f.document_row_id = p.document_row_id AND f.parent_no = p.node_no
          WHERE p.document_row_id = r.row_id AND p.parent_no IS NULL AND p.field_name::text = 'dadosOriginais'::text AND f.field_name::text = 'Formato'::text) AS formato,
    ( SELECT f.string_value
           FROM epav_data.record_fields p
             JOIN epav_data.record_fields f ON f.document_row_id = p.document_row_id AND f.parent_no = p.node_no
          WHERE p.document_row_id = r.row_id AND p.parent_no IS NULL AND p.field_name::text = 'dadosOriginais'::text AND f.field_name::text = 'Unidade Medida'::text) AS unidade
   FROM epav_data.records r
  WHERE collection_path::text = 'produtos_swift'::text;
